svg.title: Help paying for health insurance
svg.desc: Two perspectives with ten picks each. Overall ranks compare the estimated impact of all twenty points. Equal scores share a rank.
svg.text: Should Congress bring back extra help paying for health insurance?
Focus on the price of care

g.title: Monthly premiums — Eligible households pay less each month.
g.text: Eligible households pay less each month.

g.title: Treatment prices — Lower charges across many plans.
Faster relief — Restore aid through a familiar credit.
g.text: Restore aid through a familiar credit.

g.title: Out-of-pocket costs — Lower deductibles can ease visit costs.
g.text: Lower deductibles can ease visit costs.

g.title: Coverage gaps — Lower premiums may prevent lapses.
Drug prices — Ease recurring pharmacy bills.
Between jobs — Bridge a loss of employer coverage.
g.text: Bridge a loss of employer coverage.

g.title: Targeted credits — Direct extra aid to strained budgets.
g.text: Direct extra aid to strained budgets.

g.title: Independent workers — Help people buying their own plan.
g.text: Help people buying their own plan.

g.title: Other coverage — Price cuts can reach employer plans.
g.text: Price cuts can reach employer plans.

g.title: Income cutoffs — Soften premium jumps after a raise.
g.text: Soften premium jumps after a raise.

g.title: Price comparisons — Compare routine care where options exist.
g.text: Compare routine care where options exist.

g.title: Ongoing treatment — Keep appointments through a price hike.
g.text: Keep appointments through a price hike.

g.title: Local competition — More providers may improve options.
Insurance risk — Spread claims across more enrollees.
Primary care access — Nearby care may avert some ER visits.
g.text: Nearby care may avert some ER visits.

g.title: Enrollment process — Use the marketplace people know.
Federal spending — Weigh ongoing credits against other uses.
g.text: Weigh ongoing credits against other uses.

g.title: Time-limited credits — Review costs before renewing aid.
Future premiums — Slower cost growth may temper hikes.
g.text: Slower cost growth may temper hikes.

svg.text: AI impact weighs magnitude (50%), reach (30%) and duration (20%).
